title: Understanding One-hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a method used to convert categorical data into a numerical format that can be used in machine learning models. It involves creating binary columns for each category.

title: Using Age as a Feature
text: Consider how age can be represented in a model. It can be used as a continuous variable or transformed into categorical data for one-hot encoding.

title: Continuous Representation of Age
text: One way to use age data is to treat it as a continuous variable. This means using the actual age values directly in the model.

title: Categorical Representation of Age
text: Another way to use age data is to categorize it into groups (e.g., $$18-25$$, $$26-35)$$ and then apply one-hot encoding to these categories.

title: Incorrect Representation of Age
text: Using age as a binary variable (e.g., $$0$$ for under $$30$$, $$1$$ for $$30$$ and above) without considering the distribution and impact on the model might not capture the full information.
